reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Goal: extend embedded-audit proof contract so AGY can record exact Gemini 3.1 Pro model selector (exact-model provenance, no lossy `gemini`).

**Changes:**
- `schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json` adds `auditor_model: "gemini-3.1-pro-high"` and restricts it to `auditor_tool: "agy"`.
- Docs updated to describe AGY + Gemini 3.1 exact-model route and keep generic `gemini` backward compatibility.
- New regression tests + task packets + proof bundles added around AGY model selector evidence.

**Blocking issues (needs fix):**
- **Identifier mismatch vs PR description/title/scope**: PR description proposes approving `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, but diff implements **`gemini-3.1-pro-high`**.
  - Evidence: schema enum adds `gemini-3.1-pro-high` (schema diff around lines ~49–54) and tests approve `gemini-3.1-pro-high` while rejecting `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` (test file lines ~27–36).
  - Fix: choose single canonical identifier; then update **PR title/description + task packet scope/invariants + docs headings/examples + tests** to match.
- **Docs heading contradicts content**: `docs/ops/embedded-audit-proof.md` section title says “AGY Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview” but example uses `gemini-3.1-pro-high`.
  - Evidence: diff adds heading `## Canonical example: AGY Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview` while JSON below uses `"auditor_model": "gemini-3.1-pro-high"`.

- **Changed-files / allowlist mismatch**: PR description claims only 6 files changed, but diff includes additional task-packet repair files and multiple `proof/**` artifacts (including `proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-1165/**`).

prs.title: fix(governance): SKIPPED quarantine mode for proof-only contract

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Governance validator update. Add **SKIPPED quarantine mode** to proof-only contract evaluation in `validate_change_contract.py`, plus unit tests coverage for quarantine behaviors (missing sig, deleted sig path handling, auto-detect).

**Changes:**
- Add quarantine-mode branch in `validate_proof_only_closure`: SKIPPED proof requires `content_head+proof_head`, forbids `PROOF.json.sig`, audited_head not required.
- Add PROOF.json body parsing helpers and `--quarantine` CLI flag; auto-detect quarantine from SKIPPED PROOF.json in “pure proof” changes.
- Add/adjust tests for quarantine invariants and updated “proof-only valid” fixture expectations.

**Review notes (blocking):**
- Bug risk: quarantine SKIPPED detection loads PROOF.json using `head` ref, not `proof_head`. If caller uses `--head HEAD` but `--proof-head <sha>`, code can inspect wrong blob and misclassify quarantine vs audited mode. Fix: when scanning PROOF.json for `_is_quarantine_skipped_proof`, resolve text at `proof_head` (fallback to `head` only when `proof_head` absent).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py | Add quarantine-mode proof-only closure rules, CLI flag, auto-detect logic, signature presence semantics under quarantine. |
| tests/governance/test_validate_change_contract.py | Update audited proof-only “valid” fixture; add quarantine-mode tests (SKIPPED, signature forbidden, deleted sig path behavior, auto-detect). |
